scope: Verify the FreeCAD-compatible -o route chooses its documented default DXF target from an imported DXF source revision and honors ASCII/Binary output selection.

control.runtimeAuthoredInput: The existing minimal SOURCE DXF is written in a temporary directory and only its $ACADVER value is varied.
assertions: All nine source revision headers select the expected default target, including the AC1012 compatibility mapping to AC1014.
Each target is emitted as ASCII and Binary DXF with the exact $ACADVER value.
Binary DXF is checked with the R12 one-byte group-code framing for AC1009 and two-byte framing for later revisions.
All inputs remain byte-identical and each invocation exits successfully.

validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --options-only (96 total controls)

limits: This receipt covers source DXF default-version selection through the FreeCAD -o route; DWG-derived defaults, explicit-version semantics outside existing controls, and native CAD acceptance remain separately scoped.
This is CLI contract evidence, not a DWG/DXF semantic support claim.
